+WELCOME TO Low Fixa BR | Lowered Cars 🇧🇷

🔨 Last Update 
Changes to the overall game systems
New Lamborghini Aventador 2021 car
⚠ ALERTS 

- ⛔ The map is not recommended for weak devices! Make sure that your device can run the game smoothly. The map is quite heavy, with textures, meshes, and other elements that can put a lot of strain on the device. On weaker devices, the map can cause a lot of lag. Now, if you like Low Fixa BR, try lowering the graphics to improve performance and be able to play!

⌨ CONTROLS 

W - Accelerate 
S - Reverse / Brake 
A - Turn left
D - Turn right

VEHICLE FUNCTIONS

P - Hand brake
H - Horn 
L - Toggle low/high beam 
K - Foghorn

SIGNALING

Z - Left arrow 
C - Right arrow
X - Warning flash 

CAMERA

V - First-person camera

TRANSMISSION

M - Toggle between automatic and manual
E - +1 march 
Q - -1 march
